difficulty_reason: The target is a global theorem for a family of osculating groups whose dimensions and representation types can jump at singular points. Its retained core builds an intrinsic/extrinsic adiabatic-limit embedding into a fixed graded group, intersects the fine orbit strata while retaining dilation-compatible locally compact Hausdorff topology, and controls the distinct regular and singular fiber behavior through quotient-adapted Jordan–Hölder bases. The previously catalogued local basis lemma alone does not identify the HN cone or construct its global stratification. H2 is justified by this retained construction and compatibility work, not by length or publication status; H3 is not asserted.
